# The Naming Exchange (2019)

**Status:** VERBATIM SOURCE. Do not edit, tidy, or improve.
Interpretation belongs in [2009-10-26-analysis.md](2009-10-26-analysis.md).

**Provenance:** Gmail thread `169effa8515a5277`, subject "Re: David",
2019-04-05 / 2019-04-06, between `dwebs49484@aol.com` and
`charles.warloe@gmail.com`. Recovered 2026-09-19.

This thread is where **"Mr. Life Manager" is first written down**, and where the
master/apprentice framing is stated by both men in their own words, seven years
before [ADR-011](../planning/decisions.md) recorded it from memory.

---

>
> [...]
>

>
> [...]
